references.text: Joshua and the Israelites attacked early in the morning, a similar military strategy of attacking at dawn.
Gideon and his men rose early, a parallel to rising early for military action.
Saul attacked the Ammonites at the morning watch, the same tactic of a surprise attack at dawn.
Abimelech continued the assault and stormed the city, a direct continuation of this military plan.
Abraham rose early in the morning, a pattern for early action that is common in Scripture.
The phrase 'whatever your hand finds to do' is repeated here as advice to act decisively.
Samuel advises Saul to do whatever his hand finds to do, the same expression for decisive action.
